notify.bad_timezone: Unknown timezone "{zone}" — falling back to system local time.

opacity.label: Text opacity
opacity.description: Opacity applied to all three lines.

padding_h.label: Extra horizontal padding
padding_h.description: Adds space to both sides of the clock.

gap.label: Line spacing
gap.description: Vertical gap between the day, date and time lines, in pixels.

timezone.label: Timezone
timezone.description: IANA zone name such as Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh. Leave empty for system local time.

font_file.label: Font file
font_file.description: A .ttf or .otf shipped with the plugin or anywhere on disk, used for every line that has no font of its own.

day_format.label: Day format
day_format.description: strftime pattern for the first line, e.g. %A for the full weekday name.

day_size.label: Day font size
day_size.description: Font size of the weekday line, in pixels.

day_color.label: Day colour
day_color.description: A palette role such as primary, or a hex colour.

day_font.label: Day font family
day_font.description: Family name of an installed font. Leave empty to use the font file above.

date_format.label: Date format
date_format.description: strftime pattern for the second line, e.g. %d %b %Y.

date_size.label: Date font size
date_size.description: Font size of the date line, in pixels.

date_color.label: Date colour
date_color.description: A palette role such as secondary, or a hex colour.

date_font.label: Date font family
date_font.description: Family name of an installed font. Leave empty to use the font file above.

time_style.label: Time style
time_style.description: Pick a 24- or 12-hour clock, or write your own pattern.

time_format.label: Time format
time_format.description: strftime pattern for the third line, e.g. - %H:%M:%S -.

time_size.label: Time font size
time_size.description: Font size of the time line, in pixels.

time_color.label: Time colour
time_color.description: A palette role such as secondary, or a hex colour.

time_font.label: Time font family
time_font.description: Family name of an installed font. Leave empty to use the font file above.
